

```{r include=TRUE}
Caption <- CAP  |> sprintf(min(TR_TARGET),max(TR_TARGET),Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)
# Caption <- ""
UHS <- UHSTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & Vref==760 & TR %in% TR_TARGET]
DATA <- UHS[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=paste0("TR= ",TR," yr"),Y=Sa,X=Tn)][order(X)]|> unique()
DATA[X==0,X:=0.001]
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = FALSE,
  yAxis.log = FALSE,
  line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
  xAxis.legend="Tn [s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa [g]",
  group.legend="TR [yr]",
  data=DATA,
  plot.subtitle = Caption)
PLOT
```

```{r include=TRUE}
DT <-  UHSTable[SM=="aep"][ p %in%  c(0.16,0.84) & Vs30==760 ,.(AEP,Tn,p,Sa)] |> unique()
DT16 <- DT[p==0.16,.(AEP,Tn,Sa16=Sa)] 
DT84 <- DT[p==0.84,.(AEP,Tn,Sa84=Sa)] 
AUX <- DT84[DT16,on=.(AEP,Tn)] #merge(DT16,DT84,by=c("TR","Tn"),all=TRUE) |> na.omit()
AUX[,sigmaLnX:=round(0.5*(log(Sa84)-log(Sa16)),digits = 4),by=.(Tn,AEP)]
DT <- AUX[DT,on=.(Tn,AEP)] #merge(DT,AUX,by=.(Tn,TR,Vs30),all=TRUE) |> na.omit()
DATA <- DT[,.(ID=1/AEP,Y=exp(sigmaLnX),X=Tn)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)
buildPlot::buildPlot(
  library="hc",
  color.palette = "Dynamic",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=FALSE,
  xAxis.log = FALSE,
  yAxis.log = FALSE,
  xAxis.legend="Tn[s]",
  yAxis.legend="sigma[g]",
  data=DATA)

```
